title: Sarasota Wine Co.

services.name: Tasting Ticket
services.desc: Step inside our tasting room and take a journey through wine country without leaving Sarasota. Every Saturday afternoon, we open The Tasting Room: an intimate, ticketed tasting experience built around a curated flight of four wines, hand-selected by our team. Each week brings a new theme - a different region, varietal, or story to explore. Whether it's your first visit or your fiftieth, there's always something new in the glass. Come anytime in the tasting hours and explore the world of wine with our Sommelier

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Sarasota Wine Co. features a carefully curated selection of wines from around the globe, including both recognizable names and rare, boutique producers not found elsewhere in the area.
